Table "country" {
  "id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "country_name" TEXT
}

Table "ranking_criteria" {
  "id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "ranking_system_id" INTEGER
  "criteria_name" TEXT
}

Table "ranking_system" {
  "id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "system_name" TEXT
}

Table "university" {
  "id" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "country_id" INTEGER
  "university_name" TEXT
}

Table "university_ranking_year" {
  "university_id" INTEGER
  "ranking_criteria_id" INTEGER
  "year" INTEGER
  "score" INTEGER
}

Table "university_year" {
  "university_id" INTEGER
  "year" INTEGER
  "num_students" INTEGER
  "student_staff_ratio" REAL
  "pct_international_students" INTEGER
  "pct_female_students" INTEGER
}

Ref: "ranking_criteria"."ranking_system_id" > "ranking_system"."id"

Ref: "university"."country_id" > "country"."id"

Ref: "university_ranking_year"."university_id" > "university"."id"

Ref: "university_ranking_year"."ranking_criteria_id" > "ranking_criteria"."id"

Ref: "university_year"."university_id" > "university"."id"
